notes: Variant v014 is underdetermined over τούτῳ and the projection carries r00-base; herein is aligned to the phrase as it stands.
herein is aligned rather than noncompositional, both elements being spelled in the English word (rules 35, 81).
εὐάρεστος heads on its stem word pleasing (rules 66, 104), the supplied copula being the predicate adjective's helper (rule 53).
